sheet.title: Axis Empires: Dai Senso!
sheet.source: Dai Senso game map adjusted.png, 3990 x 3198; Decision Games 2011. West Map and East Map side by side, one hex grid; hexes renumbered by column from 00 at the West Map's west edge (Ben, 2026-10-30), so the printed w/e prefixes are dropped.

panel.title: Delay DRMs
panel.text: -? for the number of VPs in the box containing the Rising Sun VP marker, if Total War is in effect.
-1 if the Axis War Production marker is in the Strategic Warfare Box.

panel.title: Europe/Africa Box
panel.text: Use the Port-to-Port procedure to move to/from a port in the West Indian Ocean Naval Zone.
Use the Off-Map Box to Off-Map Box procedure to move to/from the Panama Canal Box.
Replacement Location for British non-colonial and Afr colonial units.
